errors.text_span: В графиката са представени две линии.
errors.evidence: There is only one line visually shown in the chart, with an area under it, not two separate lines.

errors.text_span: Втората, оранжева линия, започва от стойност 7,8% през 2017 г.
errors.evidence: The orange line represents the percentage increase, not starting from 7.8% in 2017 but shows annual increase percentages.

errors.text_span: увеличава се до 7,3% през 2018 г., след това до 6,8% през 2019 г., 4,4% през 2020 г.
errors.evidence: Percentage values are incorrectly mapped to years: 7.3% is for 2019, 6.8% for 2020, etc. These should be related to respective years accurately.
Description does not mention the blue area under the line, which is a key visual element.
The description does not clearly state that the chart represents the number of internet buyers in billions.
Description omits mentioning 'Купувачи (в млрд.)' label on the y-axis.

errors.text_span: показва флуктуации в стойностите през периода.
